svg.text: limn bed load cells: 3 feet, 2 × ADS1220, RP2040
2026-10-15 · plan, not yet built · pin numbers = the ADS1220 chip; the module's header uses the same names
AVDD_A = the Pro Micro's 3V3: bridge excitation, REFP0, AVDD (= DVDD, 0 Ω on the module)
ratiometric: the excitation is the reference, so its noise and drift cancel
option if the noise test asks: an LDO module from VBUS feeding AVDD_A instead
TOUCH: GP6 high = OK, Melzi pin low
touch, dead MCU or cut wire: pulled
Grounds: one star on the front-end board
the module joins its AGND and DGND (0 Ω);
the Pro Micro's GND reaches the star by one wire;
the NPN's emitter by its own wire to the Pro Micro's GND
RC: 1 kΩ + 4.7 nF to AGND per input, 47 nF Mx–MC;
S: the 47 ks are its R, 1 nF to AGND, 10 nF S–MC
Gauge wires: 32 AWG twisted triples (EXC+, mid, EXC−) per foot
